opening.message: The tavern is warm, loud, and just a little too eager to hide what happened outside. What do you do first?

gameStart.openingInstructions:
Frame the opening scene around the party arriving at the tavern with a clear reason to talk to the proprietor.
Give the selected character one personal detail to notice first, then introduce a small problem that invites immediate action.
Keep the first sequence focused on meeting the location, learning what is strange, and choosing a first lead.

Delete this file once the initial game start sequence has completed (recommended to keep it).

name: Tavern Start
description: Begin at a warm tavern with a few ready characters and an immediate reason to act.
